{{Quote|You can go about your business? Your business is my business, void-brain.|915 to Corran Horn|<ref name="X:Bacta" />}}
'''915''' was the designation of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="X:Bacta" />

During the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], he tried to arrest [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] who was under disguise. 915 [[Death/Legends|died]] from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] slash to the head.<ref name="X:Bacta" />
